summary: BlackSky Technology Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $250 million of Class A common stock through sales agents Deutsche Bank Securities and Craig-Hallum Capital Group. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices; no fixed price per share, premium, or expected close date is set. The compensation to agents is up to 3% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special-situation event.
